text_block_list.name: Baby
text_block_list.text:
"Eh, ehh... 
Waaah, waaah, waaah!"

text_block_list.name: Mother
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, there, there, it's okay... 
...What should I do? Maybe I should step 
outside for a bit...?"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"Booooono♪ Sorry to keep everyone waiting, 
okay~? 
The next act is starting soon, so please 
hold on just a little longer~."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"Hm? ...Waah, a baby! So cute~! 
Are you in a bad mood, little one? Well 
then... Ta-da! Here you go!"

text_block_list.name: Jack-in-the-Box
text_block_list.text: (Boiiiiiing!)

text_block_list.name: Baby
text_block_list.text:
"...Ehehe. 
Ehehe, ehehe!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"Ahaha♪ Did that surprise you? The treats 
in Mr. Clown's hands are made just for 
babies, so go ahead and enjoy~!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Let's all keep smiling for the rest of the 
show too, okay?♪

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
"Ah! In that case, I'll make the costumes! 
I'm pretty good at sewing! 
Let me ask you later about what kind of 
design you'd like!"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
"Then I'll handle the lighting. I've 
dabbled in theater a bit... 
so I'm fairly familiar with that kind of 
equipment."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"Thank you for your suggestions. We will 
now divide everyone into the performance, 
costume, and prop teams, so please state 
your preference—"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Phew, that's a relief. Looks like we'll 
have enough hands on deck! Now, our next 
issue is safety—delivering a performance 
that won't make our fans worry."

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
"Ah! In that case! 
We just got a marvelous proposal! ...Let's 
go☆"

text_block_list.name: Circus Member A
text_block_list.text:
"It was trending, so I tuned into the 
magic stream casually, but... 
it really resonated with me! So I was 
wondering if there was any way I could 
help—"

text_block_list.name: Circus Member A
text_block_list.text:
"I talked to the troupe leader, and he 
gave us permission to use our facilities 
as a practice space! Please, make good use 
of it!"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Really? Thank you so much! 
Hehe. I'm so glad we were blessed with 
such a wonderful connection."

text_block_list.name: Circus Member A
text_block_list.text:
"When it comes to the performance, I'll 
teach you everything I can! 
Please, don't hesitate to rely on me!"

text_block_list.name: Circus Member A
text_block_list.text:
"Is the timing still a bit off? You throw 
the club in your left hand while the first 
club from your right hand is still in 
midair!"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume C
text_block_list.text:
"Y-Yes, ma'am...!  
Right-hand club... in midair...!"

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
"Watch closely! Like this☆ 
Marveloooous★☆★"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume C
text_block_list.text:
"...S-So pretty. 
Are we supposed to do that too...?"

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"Yes. With 5 days, 2 hours, and 24 minutes 
remaining... I expect everyone to master 
this routine by then."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"The other day, I negotiated with the 
committee chair, and she arranged a 
showcase for us to demonstrate our 
performance."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"The faculty's concern is that 'if an act 
fails, it will cause the fans to worry.' 
In other words, our passing line must be—"

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"To demonstrate a 100% success rate 
without failing the act even once. 
...Please make sure to master it by the 
deadline."

text_block_list.name: Umamusume D
text_block_list.text:
"...Gah!? ...No good, again... 
What should I do? This is way harder than 
I thought..."

text_block_list.name: Umamusume D
text_block_list.text:
"Maybe I made a mistake volunteering for 
the performance team. 
I just feel like I can't keep up with 
everything—"

text_block_list.name: Circus Member A
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah! You guys are amazing! You're 
picking this up so fast! 
I guess it really pays off when you're 
fired up!"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume D
text_block_list.text:
...I don't know if I have the confidence 
to do it that well.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume C
text_block_list.text:
"...What should I do? I'll try my best, 
but... 
what if I end up dragging everyone 
down...?"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"Hellooo! Are you hungry? 
I brought some food for everyone~!"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume D
text_block_list.text:
"Phew... That was delicious~. 
It was a moment of pure bliss."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"Ahaha♪ I'm glad~. 
Did that give you some energy back?"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume C
text_block_list.text:
"...Ah. You're right. 
I feel so much better than before..."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"It's normal to lose confidence sometimes, 
you know~ Especially when you're hungry! 
It's so easy to slip into thinking, 'Maybe 
I can't do this~'."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"But you know what? Not at all! That's not 
true! 
After all, you just enjoyed a delicious 
meal! You'll be totally fine!"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume D
text_block_list.text: Bono-chan...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"If you still feel anxious, I want you to 
talk to me or Fuji-san and the others. 
...I worry too, you know! So let's worry 
together!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"Because we've all shared chanko from the 
same pot now! Whether it's worries or fun, 
let's share it all together♪"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume C
text_block_list.text:
"...Yeah. Thank you, Bono-chan... 
I'll take some time to properly think 
about what I should do!"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, Akebono. ...I saw what you did 
earlier. 
Thank you for looking out for the new 
members."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"It was wonderfully thoughtful of you. 
I'm so glad we have you on our team."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"Ehehe♪ Yay! 
I'm so happy to hear I was able to help!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Because that's what I wanted to do.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: What you wanted to do?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"Yup! ...Hey, hey, listen to this, 
Fuji-san! 
I want to become the circus tent!!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"Everyone's taking on the circus with such 
wonderful feelings in their hearts, 
right?\nI wanna support that~. ——Just like 
a big top tent!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"Tents are super big, and they wrap around 
everyone, you know?\nWhen you go inside, 
you feel safe~, and all warm!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"In other words, the tent is like the 
circus's chanko nabe!\nAnd not just for 
the audience! For Fuji-san and the others 
too!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"——So that everyone can smile.\nI wanna 
support them, yep."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"……Fufu. I see.\nThat sounds just like 
you."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"Following our recent consultation... we 
made minor adjustments to the program and 
divided the performers into teams to 
create an environment where everyone can 
easily discuss their concerns."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"Improving the situation is an urgent 
matter to keep to our schedule...\nWe will 
continue to welcome your feedback. Thank 
you very much for your cooperation."

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: "Yes!\nWe're counting on you too!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"Mm-hmm. Everyone smiling is the 
best!\nRight! ——Aha♪"
